stages.desc: Every new lead enters here regardless of source. 12-day sprint to qualify and route. Fully automated except Day 1 live call and Day 12 review task. Copy here stays neutral (works for a buyer or a seller) until Day 12 routing moves them into the Buyer or Seller pipeline, where the messaging gets specific.

cards.body: Meta leads only. Instant Messenger fires on form submit with GIF intro + "Are you looking to buy or sell?" Qualifying flow captures phone → N8N → GHL → Adrian notified. All other sources skip to Day 1.
Adrian calls immediately. Use Buyer or Seller script depending on form type. Goal: qualify timeline, understand intent, book appointment.

Slybroadcast VM fires via N8N + simultaneous Lipdub GIF: "Hi [Name], it's Graeham, just gave you a call. Text me back whenever works and we'll get going." + calendar link.
Slybroadcast script: "Hey, it's Graeham, sorry I missed you. Happy to help whenever you're ready, whether you're buying or selling. Text me or give me a call when you get a minute. Thanks."
Same Lipdub video embedded as GIF + intro to Graeham + graehamwatts.com + calendar link. Subject: "Tried to reach you, quick video inside"
"Hey [Name], did you get a chance to watch that video? Any questions, just reply. Or grab a time here, whatever's easier." + calendar link.

AI agent call. If no answer: Slybroadcast VM with different angle, mentions a recent sale or listing in their area.
Slybroadcast script: "Hey, it's Graeham again. A place just sold right near you and the number caught me off guard. Call me when you get a chance and I'll tell you about it."
"Hey, here's a quick video on how I work with [buyers/sellers] around EPA." Jason library asset — no name needed. + calendar link.
HeyGen market update for their target area embedded as GIF. Subject: "What the EPA market looks like right now" Educational, no pitch.

Second AI call + Slybroadcast VM. Different message — timely market stat or new listing in their target area.
Slybroadcast script: "Hey, it's Graeham. A couple homes sold in your area this week, and a new listing just came up. Call me back and I'll fill you in."
Testimonial video matching their type. YouTube GIF thumbnail. Subject: "A recent EPA client story"
GIF text — casual. "If [buying/selling] is still on the table, here's my calendar if you want to talk it through."
Adrian second personal call. Different time of day from Day 1. Use buyer or seller script — note any responses received.
"Here's how we've helped families in the area find success." YouTube video as GIF + calendar link.
"I'll give you some space. If your plans change, I'm around. Want me to keep you posted on the market in the meantime? Reply Yes or No."

ADRIAN: Review all data. Route to correct pipeline. Active/Within 3mo/Under 9mo/Over 9mo Buyer or Seller. Cold if no engagement. Unqualified if spam/wrong number. Nobody stays in New Leads after Day 12.

stages.desc: Adrian reached the contact but they didn't engage meaningfully. Continues the 12-day sprint cadence with adjusted messaging.
stages.stub: Cadence: Continues Days 2–12 of the New — Uncontacted sequence. Adjustment: Adrian's Day 10 call references the prior contact attempt explicitly ("we connected briefly on [date], wanted to follow up").

stages.desc: Lead replied with intent. Highest-priority stage. Adrian's goal: book consultation in next 48 hours and route to correct active pipeline.

cards.body: Adrian calls back immediately. Discovery: timeline, criteria, motivation. Push for consultation booking.

ADRIAN: Booked → Appointment Scheduled. Qualified but not yet booked → route to active pipeline by timeline. Unresponsive → back to Contacted - No Response.
